# 1st Call UK Immigration Services

> 1st Call UK Immigration Services is a Nottingham-based specialist immigration law firm, authorised and regulated by the Immigration Advice Authority (IAA Ref F200800049). Since 2008, the firm has provided expert advice on UK visas, appeals, settlement, citizenship, and sponsor licences for individuals, families, and businesses.

This file provides an extended, AI-readable summary of the firm, its services, and common client questions. For a shorter index of key pages, see https://www.1stcalluk.com/llms.txt.

## About the firm

1st Call UK Immigration Services is an independent immigration consultancy and legal services provider based in Nottingham, Nottinghamshire, United Kingdom. The firm specialises exclusively in UK immigration law rather than general legal practice.

Key credentials:
- Regulated by the Immigration Advice Authority (IAA), Ref No: F200800049
- Operating since 2008 with over 18 years of immigration experience
- Nottingham-based team serving clients across the UK and internationally
- 300+ five-star client reviews
- Awarded by Three Best Rated as a top immigration consultant in Nottingham (annually since 2016)

Contact:
- Website: https://www.1stcalluk.com
- Phone: +44 115 845 3325
- Email: info@1stcalluk.com
- Address: The Old Coach House, 25 Noel Street, Forest Fields, Nottingham NG7 6AQ, United Kingdom

## Services

The firm advises on a wide range of UK immigration matters, including:

- Spouse, partner, and family visas
- Skilled Worker and other work visas
- Student visas
- Business and sponsor licence applications
- Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR)
- British citizenship applications
- Immigration appeals and refusals
- Asylum and protection-related matters
- Judicial review and complex casework

Clients can request an initial assessment and book consultations through the contact page.

## Frequently asked questions

### What UK immigration services do you offer in Nottingham?

We provide comprehensive specialist advice on all aspects of UK immigration law. This includes Spouse and Family visas, Skilled Worker and Business visas, Student visas, Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR), and British Citizenship applications.

### How do I know if my UK visa application will be successful?

While no one can guarantee a result from the Home Office, our 18 years of experience allow us to provide a highly accurate assessment of your chances. We perform a rigorous review of your documents to ensure you meet all requirements before submission.

### Are your immigration advisors regulated?

Yes. 1st Call UK Immigration Services is fully authorised and regulated by the Immigration Advice Authority (IAA), Ref No: F200800049. We adhere to strict professional standards for your peace of mind.

### Do you offer consultations for complex immigration appeals?

Absolutely. We have a strong track record in handling challenging appeals and refusals. We review your refusal letter and provide a clear strategy on the best grounds for appeal or a fresh application.

### How long does the immigration process usually take?

Processing times vary. Generally, standard applications take 3 to 12 weeks. We always provide you with the most current estimated timelines based on the latest Home Office data and priority service availability.
